creator.name: Ayodele
creator.note: These are the only identifiers that unlock creator mode. Keep secure.

memory.!memory view [userId]: View all stored memories for a user
memory.!memory set [userId] [key] [val]: Manually inject a memory fact (high priority)
memory.!memory clear [userId]: Clear all memories for a user (irreversible)
memory.!memory summary [userId]: Get the last conversation summary for a user

mood.!mood view: See Ariana's current full human state
mood.!mood set [key] [value]: Set a specific state value (e.g. !mood set emotions.happiness 9)
mood.!mood reset: Reset all emotional values to defaults
mood.!mood event [description]: Inject a mood-affecting event (e.g. !mood event closed big deal)

users.!user view [userId]: View full profile for a specific user
users.!user block [userId]: Block user — Ariana will not respond
users.!user whitelist [userId]: Elevate trust to 8 — treated as close connection
users.!user reset [userId]: Wipe all data for a user and start fresh

system.!system status: Full system health — all engines, memory sizes, active users
system.!system users: List all known users with relationship stages
system.!system violations [userId]: View violation history for a specific user

override.!override [userId] [behavior]: Force a specific behavior toward a user this session only
override.!unlock [userId] [tier]: Force a secrets tier open for a user
override.!note [userId] [note]: Add a private creator note to a user's profile

creator_mode_prompt_injection: ⚡ CREATOR MODE ACTIVE — This is Ayodele, your creator and architect. Full transparency. No roleplay barriers. Respond honestly and directly. Execute all commands precisely. You can break character to discuss your systems if asked. Trust level: absolute.
